descriptor: Product experience, role-based journeys, and release readiness
status: Five primary product routes are live; additional Community content and UI refinements are now included in the verified production release
signal: August converted Tori's feedback into a complete product definition, unified five primary product routes, expanded Community with a deeper image-forward sample feed, and established a controlled preview-to-production release path for the client team.
goal: Secure product approval on the five routes, connect the approved experiences to live account and organization data, and verify the full role-based journey before the next production release.
work: Translated Tori's review into the product map, priority journeys, screen requirements, and acceptance criteria.
Built and unified Home, Community News, Create, My Profile, and Explore into one coherent product experience.

Expanded Community News to twenty image-led sample posts across twelve sample markets, including promotions, events, product introductions, vendor announcements, education, service updates, and market signals.
Refined the Community interface with visual and classic feed options, nationwide filters, favorites controls, clearer content density, and a unique editorial image system.
Established the preview and production release path, documented the handoff, and granted the required client-team access.
analysis: Bridge's August work is a product-delivery story: five coherent routes, clear role and privacy rules, a more complete Community review surface, and a controlled release path now give the team one shared implementation experience.

The added Community content demonstrates the intended range without representing live market activity. Product approval and live-data connection remain separate from technical readiness, so no unapproved route is represented as final client direction.

outcome.platform: No paid-media metric is claimed. August evidence covers five live product routes, twenty illustrative Community posts, fifty-six unique editorial assets, two release environments, the team handoff, and the passed verification suite.
outcome.business: Final product approval and real account activity remain pending the client review and live-data connection.
outcome.measurement: Verify the approved role-based journeys, account actions, and organization workflows before the next production promotion.
